details.text: Wednesday through Monday. There is a low probability for thunderstorms late Wednesday evening into very early Thursday morning to maintain a gusty to locally damaging wind threat. Additionally, a threat for repeated rounds of heavier rain through this period could result in localized flash flooding. If confidence in a more widespread threat develops, a Flood Watch may be needed.
